note: The traveller's introduction under Why We Added It to the Portfolio, written from the stay's own filed facts and approved by James. A stay with no entry opens with its filed line.

intros.aguas-claras: Aguas Claras is a small, art-filled hideaway on Costa Rica's Caribbean coast. Twelve individually styled rooms and bungalows sit in the garden, a private gate opens onto Playa Chiquita, and evenings bring live local music at Papaya. Reef and rainforest are both close, and the days stay slow and private.
intros.aguas-arriba-lodge: Aguas Arriba Lodge is a wooden mountain house with five suites on the east shore of Lago del Desierto, 37 kilometres from El Chaltén. You arrive by boat or on foot, and Fitz Roy stands across the water.
intros.amazon-field-station-byinkaterra: Amazon Field Station by Inkaterra is one of the rare places where guests live inside active rainforest research. Conservation work goes on around you, and you leave having learned from the Amazon as well as seen it.
intros.amor-arenal: Amor Arenal sits in a private rainforest reserve beneath Arenal Volcano. Each casita is tucked into the forest with a heated outdoor whirlpool, so the stay is private, quiet and open to jungle and volcano views.
intros.arenas-del-mar-resort: Arenas del Mar is where rainforest, wildlife and the Pacific meet. You wake among the animals of the forest, spend the afternoon on a secluded beach and end the day with the sun going down over the ocean.
intros.awasi-atacama: Awasi Atacama gives you the desert at your own pace. Every day is planned around your curiosity, from hikes among salt ridges to sunrise beneath the volcanoes.
intros.iguazu: Awasi Iguazú is hidden in the Atlantic rainforest near Iguazú Falls. Every stay is privately tailored, so the falls, the forest and its wildlife become part of your daily rhythm.
intros.awasi-patagonia: Awasi Patagonia is one of the most intimate wilderness stays in South America. Each stay is privately tailored to the traveller, with glaciers, wildlife and silence as the setting.
intros.bahia-bustamante-lodge: Bahía Bustamante began in the 1950s as a seaweed gathering village on the Atlantic coast of Patagonia. The founder's grandson turned it into a nature lodge between the sea and the steppe, and the family still runs it.
intros.blancaneaux-lodge: Blancaneaux Lodge sets thatched cabañas and villas above Privassion Creek in Belize's Mountain Pine Ridge Forest Reserve. Rivers, waterfalls and Maya heritage shape the days, and the sound of the water sets the pace.
intros.blue-reef-island: Blue Reef Island is a three-acre private island, 20 to 30 minutes by boat from Dangriga. Five air-conditioned cabanas face the Caribbean, each with its own veranda and dock.
intros.chez-georges: Chez Georges is a seven suite modernist villa on a hilltop in Santa Teresa, between Rio's centre and the beaches of Copacabana and Ipanema. The pool looks over protected forest, with Sugarloaf in view.
intros.coco-costa-rica: The Coco pods at Art Villas hang above the treetops, joined by wooden skybridges and resting nets. They suit couples who want to sleep in the canopy, with the rest of Art Villas and its concierge close by.
intros.coco-plum-island-resort: Coco Plum Island Resort is a locally owned, adults-only, all-inclusive island off Belize's southern coast, and the only place on its cay. The day follows the tide, the breeze and the water beyond your veranda.
intros.ecocamp-patagonia: EcoCamp Patagonia is the region's first geodesic dome hotel. You wake with mountain peaks at the door and spend the days on the trails, and every stay supports conservation and community.
intros.el-mapi-byinkaterra: El MaPi by Inkaterra is a contemporary base at the gateway to Machu Picchu. It sits where the Andes begin to fall toward the Amazon Basin, among mist-covered mountains and rushing rivers.
intros.explora-rapa-nui: Explora Rapa Nui is a base for exploring the world's most remote inhabited island. Days go to volcanic landscapes, the ancient Moai and living Polynesian culture.
intros.explora-sacred-valley: Explora Sacred Valley takes you through the heart of the Incan world. Machu Picchu and the valley are explored in depth, with connection put ahead of crowds.
intros.explora-torres-del-paine: Explora Torres del Paine stands inside the national park itself. You wake among glaciers, granite towers and turquoise lakes, with the Patagonian wilderness in every direction.
intros.fazenda-moreias: Fazenda Moréias is a working farm on the coast of Ceará, between Preá and Barra Grande. Eight architect-designed bungalows and houses share nine kilometres of the farm's own beach.
intros.felissimo-exclusive-hotel: Felissimo Exclusive Hotel has fifteen suites, including two houses, in a hillside garden at Balneário Camboriú on the coast of Santa Catarina. No two suites are the same.
intros.futangue-hotel-spa: Futangue Hotel & Spa sits inside Parque Futangue, a private 13,500 hectare reserve of Valdivian rainforest on the south shore of Lake Ranco. The hotel has 26 rooms, and the reserve is yours to explore.
intros.gaia-riverlodge: Gaïa Riverlodge stands above the Five Sisters Waterfalls in Belize's Mountain Pine Ridge Forest Reserve. The lodge is off the grid and makes its own power from the river below its thatched cabanas.
intros.hamanasi: Hamanasi sits on the beach at Hopkins on Belize's southern coast, with rainforest behind it. You sleep on the beachfront or in a treehouse room in the canopy, and the resort's own dive operation and day trips cover reef and forest.
intros.hidden-valley-lodge: Hidden Valley is a private lodge inside its own 7,200-acre reserve in the Mountain Pine Ridge. Pine forest gives way to rainforest here, with waterfalls and more than 100 miles of trails to walk.
intros.iguana-crossing: Iguana Crossing faces the long beach at Puerto Villamil on Isabela Island in the Galápagos. Its 14 rooms look to the ocean or inland to the volcano, and the pool sits above the sand.
intros.inkaterra-cabo-blanco: Inkaterra Cabo Blanco stands on Peru's wild northern edge, where the desert meets the Pacific. It is a place to reset, with space, silence and an open horizon.
intros.inkaterra-hacienda-concepcion: Inkaterra Hacienda Concepción is a lodge deep in the Peruvian Amazon rainforest. You wake to the sounds of the forest and spend the days close to its wildlife.
intros.inkaterra-hacienda-urubamba: Inkaterra Hacienda Urubamba is an Andean hacienda between Cusco and Machu Picchu. It shows you the Sacred Valley beyond sightseeing, through its landscapes, traditions and farming.
intros.inkaterra-la-casona: Inkaterra La Casona is a restored colonial manor hidden in the cobblestone streets of Cusco. The stay is intimate and rooted in the history and culture of the city.
intros.inkaterra-machu-picchu-pueblo-hotel: Inkaterra Machu Picchu Pueblo Hotel sits in a living cloud forest beside Machu Picchu Pueblo. You wake among orchids, and the journey to the citadel begins before you leave the grounds.
intros.isla-palenque-resort: Isla Palenque is a 400-acre private island in Panama's Gulf of Chiriquí, rich in primary forest, with seven secluded beaches. Only eight beachfront casitas and one villa estate share it.
intros.isla-secas-panama: Islas Secas is one resort across 14 volcanic islands in Panama's Gulf of Chiriquí, reached only by private plane or boat. Guests dive, watch whales in season and spend whole days on an uninhabited island.
intros.jaguar-reef-lodge: The Lodge at Jaguar Reef has been a beachfront base near Hopkins, the Garifuna fishing village on Belize's southern coast, for over twenty years. Suites and villas face the water, and the sea sets the pace.
intros.ka-ana-resort: Ka'ana, whose name means heavenly place in the Maya language, is a boutique hotel on the edge of the wilderness in San Ignacio. It is a quiet base for exploring Belize's Maya heartland, from a rainforest trail to a private garden.
intros.kura-boutique-resort: Kura is an adults-only hotel of just eight suites, created by architect Martin Wells and biologist Alejandra Umaña. It is perched above Uvita on Costa Rica's southern Pacific coast, with rainforest on one side and the ocean as the horizon.
intros.la-ferme-de-georges: La Ferme de Georges is a small pousada of thatched lodges and organic gardens at Atins in Maranhão. It sits beside the Lençóis Maranhenses National Park and its great field of dunes and lagoons.
intros.lapa-rios-lodge: Lapa Rios is a rainforest lodge on Costa Rica's Osa Peninsula, where nature comes first. You wake to howler monkeys, walk jungle trails with guides and have quiet beaches close by.
intros.luna-volcan: Luna Volcán sits in 35 hectares of Andean forest on the flank of the Tungurahua volcano, about 400 metres above the town of Baños. It has thirty rooms and four volcanic hot pools.
intros.mashpi-lodge: Mashpi Lodge is a 24 room, glass-walled lodge at 900 metres in the cloud forest of north-west Ecuador. It stands inside a private reserve, about three hours' drive from Quito.
intros.matachica-resort-and-spa: Matachica is a barefoot hideaway on a quiet stretch of northern Ambergris Caye, with the Belize Barrier Reef a mile offshore. Its 33 thatched-roof casitas and villas sit among the palms.
intros.napo-wildlife-center: Napo Wildlife Center stands on Añangucocha Lagoon inside Yasuní National Park in the Ecuadorian Amazon. It is owned and run by the Kichwa Añangu community, whose territory this is.
intros.nayara-bocas-del-toro: Nayara Bocas del Toro is an adults-only, all inclusive stay on its own private island in Panama's Caribbean. Overwater villas and bamboo treehouses sit among mangroves, marine life and bioluminescent water.
intros.nayara-gardens: Nayara Gardens sits in tropical gardens below Arenal Volcano, where thousands of planted Cecropia trees draw resident sloths. Private plunge pools and rainforest hot spring pools fill the hours between outings.
intros.nayara-hangaroa: Nayara Hangaroa sits on the ocean on Rapa Nui, about 3,700 km out in the Pacific and one flight from Santiago. It is a stay surrounded by sacred history, volcanic cliffs and open sea.
intros.arenal-springs-camp-by-nayara: Arenal Springs Camp by Nayara is an adults-only stay on Nayara's Arenal campus. Each villa has its own plunge pool fed by mineral hot springs from the volcano, set in a private garden.
intros.nayara-tented-camp: Nayara Tented Camp raises its tents on stilts above a reforested rainforest near Arenal Volcano. Each has its own pool fed by mineral hot springs, and you can watch sloths and toucans from the deck.
intros.pacuare-lodge: Pacuare Lodge lies deep in the rainforest on the Pacuare River, and arriving by whitewater raft is part of the stay. You wake to toucans, and the days mix rafting, forest and quiet.
intros.sacha-lodge: Sacha Lodge sits on Pilchicocha Lake in Ecuador's Amazon, inside its own 2,000 hectare reserve next to Yasuní National Park. You reach it by canoe down the Napo, and the reserve has been protected for more than 30 years.
intros.senda-monteverde-lodge: Senda sits at the foot of the Monteverde cloud forest, high on the Continental Divide. On clear days the view runs across the highlands to the Gulf of Nicoya, and a hanging bridge leads into the forest.
intros.sleeping-giant-rainforest-lodge: The Rainforest Lodge at Sleeping Giant is a riverside lodge in the Sibun River Valley, at the foothills of the Maya Mountains. It sits just off the Hummingbird Highway and faces the ridge it is named for.
intros.st-george-s-caye-resort: St. George's Caye Resort is a small, adults-only retreat on a private island seven miles from Belize City. There are no roads or cars, and the day moves between turquoise water and reef.
intros.tabacon-thermal-resort-spa: At Tabacón a naturally heated thermal river, born from Arenal Volcano, winds through tropical gardens in pools and waterfalls. Hotel guests have unlimited access to the river, and the days slow down around it.
intros.thatch-caye-resort: Thatch Caye Resort is an all-inclusive private island nine miles off Dangriga. It hosts only 30 guests at a time, in overwater bungalows and oceanfront cabanas.
intros.the-art-villa: The Art Villa is a five-bedroom home in concrete, steel and glass that steps across the rainforest canopy above the Pacific. It suits families and groups who want a whole architect-designed house to themselves, with a concierge to arrange the day.
intros.the-atelier-villa: At The Atelier the walls slide away, so the jungle becomes part of the house. It is a private, architect-designed villa on Costa Rica's Pacific coast, with its own pool and a concierge to arrange the day.
intros.the-lodge-at-chaa-creek: Mick and Lucy Fleming welcomed their first guests at Chaa Creek in 1981, making it one of Belize's first eco-resorts. Today its 28 accommodations look over the Macal River, and the forest is part of the stay.
intros.the-singular-patagonia: The Singular Patagonia is a 57 room hotel inside a 1915 cold storage plant on Última Esperanza Fjord, five kilometres from Puerto Natales. The engine room is still intact, and Torres del Paine is a day trip away.
intros.beckon-tierra-atacama: Tierra Atacama sits at the heart of Chile's Atacama Desert, the driest in the world. Contemporary comfort meets traditional desert architecture, and the days go to the open land and its skies.
intros.tierra-patagonia: Tierra Patagonia is set on the edge of Torres del Paine National Park. It gives guided access to the mountains, lakes, glaciers and wildlife, and warm design to come back to.
intros.turtle-inn: Turtle Inn is a barefoot hideaway on Belize's Placencia Peninsula, with thatched-roof cottages and a Balinese-inspired style. Days unfold between the sea, the garden and the village.
intros.umaya-resort-and-marina: Umaya Resort & Adventures sits on the northern stretch of the Placencia Peninsula, with the Caribbean on one side and a mangrove-lined lagoon on the other. Suites face the beach or the lagoon.
intros.victoria-house: Victoria House is a 42-room resort on the beach at San Pedro, Ambergris Caye, at the edge of the Belize Barrier Reef. It runs from staterooms and casitas to private villas with their own pools.
intros.wymara: Wymara is two places under one name on Grace Bay. The Resort is sociable and stylish around its infinity pool, and the Villas, the first Forbes Five-Star villas in Turks and Caicos, have overwater sundecks and an in-ocean pool.
intros.xanadu-island-resort: Xanadu Island Resort sits on the beach a mile south of San Pedro Town on Ambergris Caye. Its dome suites are close enough for the town's restaurants and far enough for quiet gardens and sea air.
intros.bamurru-plains: Bamurru Plains is a bush camp of twelve bungalows on the Mary River floodplain at the edge of Kakadu, for 26 guests at most. Airboats cross the flooded plains among magpie geese, egrets and crocodiles, and the mesh walls keep the floodplain with you through the night.
intros.clayoquot-wilderness-resort: Clayoquot Wilderness Lodge is a tented lodge hidden in ancient temperate rainforest in Canada, reached only by water or air. Most guests fly to Vancouver and continue by seaplane.
intros.dove-island-lodge: Dove Island Lodge is the Lambeth family's private island in Sitka Sound, for no more than 28 guests a night. The lodge keeps its own de Havilland Beaver floatplane, a Himalayan salt spa and a five course dinner every evening.
intros.torres-del-paine-c-reserve: Explora Torres del Paine C. Reserve sits in protected reserve land bordering one of South America's best known wilderness regions. Days are given to Patagonia seen through conservation and rewilding, at an unhurried pace.
intros.galapagos-safari-camp: Galapagos Safari Camp is the only tented camp in the Galápagos highlands, with nine Safari Tents and a three-bedroom Family Suite on 55 hectares of rewilded farmland on Santa Cruz, at the border of the national park. Giant tortoises wander by the tents, and day boats reach the other islands.
intros.inkaterra-reserva-amazonica: Inkaterra Reserva Amazonica is a lodge of thatched cabanas beside the Tambopata National Reserve, in the Peruvian Amazon. You fly to Puerto Maldonado and wake to the sounds of the rainforest.
intros.kenai-fjords-wilderness-lodge: Kenai Fjords Wilderness Lodge has eight waterfront cabins on Fox Island in Resurrection Bay, 12 miles south of Seward and reached only by boat. The way out takes in a day in Kenai Fjords National Park. Guests are 12 and over.
intros.manshausen: Manshausen is a private island above the Arctic Circle in Steigen, founded by the polar explorer Børge Ousland. Seven Sea Cabins sit on the rocks with floor to ceiling windows, beside two Towers with full roof windows.
intros.noah-forest-by-tifakara: Noah's Forest by Tifakara is a rainforest retreat a short distance from La Fortuna, with Arenal Volcano as the backdrop. You fall asleep to the sounds of the jungle, take yoga by the river and swim with a view of the volcano.
intros.odyssey-lodge: Odyssey Lodge sits on China Poot Bay in Kachemak Bay, four miles by boat from Homer, with mountains and glaciers across the water. Private cabins for two to four share a sauna above the bay, with bears and sea otters on the doorstep.
intros.pikaia-lodge: Pikaia Lodge has fourteen rooms on the rim of an extinct volcanic crater in the Santa Cruz highlands, at 450 metres. It keeps a giant tortoise reserve on its own land and its own yacht to reach the other islands by day.
intros.sal-salis: Sal Salis is a camp of sixteen safari tents in the dunes of Cape Range National Park, a few steps from Ningaloo Reef. Whale sharks pass from mid-March to October and humpback whales from August. The camp reopens, refurbished, in late March 2027.
intros.siempang-forest-lodge: Siempang Forest Lodge is fifteen safari tents on a forest ridge inside Siem Pang Wildlife Sanctuary, home to the giant ibis, Cambodia's national bird. The sanctuary is co-managed by Rising Phoenix with Cambodia's Ministry of Environment.
intros.sorrisniva: Sorrisniva Arctic Wilderness Lodge sits on the banks of the Alta River in Finnmark, far above the Arctic Circle, and is open all year. Winter brings the northern lights and an Igloo Hotel rebuilt from snow each season. Summer brings the midnight sun and the river.
intros.talon-lodge: Talon Lodge & Spa has its own island in Sitka Sound, facing Mount Edgecumbe, for no more than 24 guests at a time. Days go to salmon and halibut boats and floatplane fly-outs, with a spa over the water.
intros.the-arctic-hideaway: The Arctic Hideaway is a handful of tiny timber houses on Sørvær in the Fleinvær archipelago, about an hour by express boat from Bodø, with no cars and no shops. It began as an artist residency. Each guest has a small sleeping cabin with a sea view and shares the kitchen, studio and sauna.
intros.lindis-lodge: The Lindis rests almost unseen on the floor of the Ahuriri Valley, on a 6,500 acre high-country station in New Zealand. Five suites and three mirrored Pods look onto the valley, and the lodge holds Two MICHELIN Keys.
intros.ultima-thule-lodge: Ultima Thule Lodge is the Claus family's fly-in lodge on the Chitina River, inside Wrangell-St. Elias National Park and 100 miles from the road. No more than 14 guests stay at a time, with a bush plane and pilot for every two.
intros.vermejo-ted-turner-reserve: Vermejo is 558,000 acres of mountain, meadow and alpine tundra in New Mexico, restored for bison and elk. You stay at Casa Grande, a turn-of-the-century stone mansion, at Costilla Fishing Lodge or at Turner House.
intros.woodnest-odda: Woodnest is four treehouses hanging in the pines on the mountainside above Odda and its fjord. The only way in is on foot, a steep hike of 20 to 60 minutes up stone steps and stairs.
intros.awasi-mendoza: Awasi Mendoza is a small lodge of private villas among vineyards in the Uco Valley, beneath the Andes. Days are built around wine country at a slow pace. Mendoza's airport is about 110 km away, a drive of one and a half to two hours.
intros.awasi-santa-catarina: Awasi Santa Catarina sits between Atlantic rainforest and the sea on Brazil's southern coast, with private villas and a great deal of privacy. Florianópolis airport is about 65 km away, around an hour and a half by road.
intros.boluntiku-hotel: Bolontiku is a lakeside hotel of 15 suites on Lake Petén Itzá, on one of the few stretches of the lake where you can swim. It has its own Temazcal sweat lodge, and Tikal is just over an hour away.
intros.casa-palopo: Casa Palopó is a colourful, art-filled house of 15 rooms and suites and a three-bedroom villa on Lake Atitlán, at Santa Catarina Palopó. Maya culture shapes the stay: you can paint with the village families, then look at the stars over the lake through a telescope.
intros.villa-bokeh: Villa Bokéh has fifteen rooms and suites among gardens and a lagoon, in the shadow of the volcanoes about 3 km from the centre of Antigua Guatemala. Canoe across the lagoon to a picnic for two, then eat at Bokéh 3.1.
intros.explora-el-calafate: Explora El Calafate is a base for Patagonia's glaciers, hidden valleys and open pampas, explored by day with Explora's guides. Evenings are warm, quiet and simple. You arrive through El Calafate's airport.
intros.explora-el-chalten: Explora El Chaltén stands in a private conservation reserve among forests, glaciers and rivers, beneath Patagonia's best known peaks. You arrive through El Calafate's airport.
intros.explora-at-atacama: Explora Atacama is a base for exploring the Atacama Desert in depth, for walkers, photographers and the curious. It is about an hour and a half by road from Calama airport.
intros.nayara-alto-atacama: Nayara Alto Atacama sits in a valley near San Pedro de Atacama, under famously clear skies. Days cross the desert's Mars-like terrain and end by candlelight beneath the Milky Way. Calama airport is one and a half to two hours away by road.
intros.uxua-casa-hotel-spa: UXUA Casa Hotel & Spa is a collection of individual casas in Bahia, for travellers drawn to creativity, culture and barefoot ease on Brazil's coast. Porto Seguro airport is about an hour and a half away, including a ferry crossing.
intros.belmond-monasterio: Monasterio, A Belmond Hotel, stands in Cusco on the foundations of an Inca palace, in a monastery built in 1595 around a courtyard with a 300 year old cedar. It has 97 rooms and 20 suites, a gilded baroque chapel and two restaurants. Cusco airport is twenty minutes away by road, and Machu Picchu is three and a half hours by train.
intros.aliikai-voyage: Aliikai is a sailing yacht that carries small groups through the islands of eastern Indonesia on itineraries built around each charter. Sail her shared or take her privately, and pair the voyage with land stays in Bali or Sumba before or after.
intros.amandari: Amandari is Aman's village retreat above the Ayung River valley near Ubud, with thatched suites, walled gardens and a terraced pool that drops toward the jungle. Days hold the dawn water blessing at Tirta Empul, valley treks and rafting on the Ayung. Ngurah Rai airport is about an hour and a half by road.
intros.amanwana: Amanwana is seventeen tents on the shore of Moyo Island, inside Moyo Satonda National Park on the Flores Sea, with the jungle behind and the reef in front. Stays are full board, and ten tents or more makes the whole camp yours. Fly to Sumbawa Besar, then a 45 minute speedboat.
intros.bawah-reserve: Bawah Reserve is six islands and three lagoons in Indonesia's Anambas, with suites, overwater bungalows and villas sold all inclusive on a three night minimum. Elang, its own island within the group, has six cliffside lodges, a club house and two beaches kept for its guests. Bawah's seaplane flies in from Batam.
intros.cap-karoso: Cap Karoso is forty rooms and twenty villas on a coral reef shore in West Sumba, with planted roofs, a farm of its own and dinners from what it grows. Surf and snorkel boat trips, a shamanic healing journey and a kids club fill the days. Tambolaka airport is about 50 minutes by road, or 15 minutes by helicopter.
intros.celestia-yacht: Celestia is a handcrafted phinisi that sails the Coral Triangle of eastern Indonesia, with a private dive guide aboard and dinners set on empty beaches. She suits a family or small group who want the islands to themselves.
intros.como-shambhala-estate: COMO Shambhala Estate is a wellness retreat in the jungle above the Ayung River near Ubud, built around a natural spring the Balinese hold sacred. Pool villas, suites and five residences sit among the trees, and stays are shaped around the estate's programmes of rest and renewal. Ngurah Rai airport is the gateway.
intros.hotel-indigo-bali-seminyak-beach: Hotel Indigo Bali Seminyak Beach is a beachfront base on Seminyak with 289 rooms, suites and pool villas, each with a balcony or patio and daybeds. SugarSand, the hotel's bar, sits on the sand. Ngurah Rai airport is the nearest.
intros.kayumanis-jimbaran-private-estates: Kayumanis Jimbaran Private Estate is twenty walled pool villas in a former coconut grove, minutes from Jimbaran's sunset beach and its fishing village. Each villa has a semi open living room, a kitchenette and an open air garden bath. Ngurah Rai airport is close by.
intros.kayumanis-nusa-dua: Kayumanis Nusa Dua is a small estate of walled garden villas, each with its own pool and a personal butler, a short walk from the white sand of Nusa Dua. Floating breakfasts, beach picnics and Balinese massage are part of the stay. Ngurah Rai airport is about 25 minutes away, with the transfer included.
intros.kayumanis-sanur: Kayumanis Sanur is eleven private pool villas along a stone path through a garden laid out like a Balinese village. Villas run from one to three bedrooms, for couples and families who want space of their own near the Sanur shore. Ngurah Rai airport is the gateway.
intros.kayumanis-ubud: Kayumanis Ubud is a hideaway of pool villas in tropical forest above the Ayung River, with its spa raised over the river and a dining corner high above the valley. Riverside picnics, rice paddy treks and a cooking class with a herb garden tour fill the days. It is reached by road from Ngurah Rai airport.
intros.mutiara-laut: Mutiara Laut is a wooden schooner with seven cabins, sailing journeys across Indonesia's Coral Triangle. She suits families, couples and small groups who want a private voyage, and Komodo airport on Flores is the usual place to board.
intros.nihi: NIHI Sumba is 31 villas and estates along Nihiwatu Beach on Sumba, facing the wave called Occy's Left, which is limited to 15 surfers a day. The Spa Safari at Nihioka, rides with Sandalwood ponies and a kids club fill the rest. Fly about an hour from Bali to Tambolaka for the included transfer, or come by helicopter.
intros.nikoi-island: Nikoi Island is a barefoot island of beach houses off Bintan, ringed by reef, with snorkelling, sailing, kayaking and a jungle zip line for families. From Singapore it is a ferry, a drive and a 20 minute speedboat, under three hours with no flights.
intros.silolona-sojourns: Silolona is a traditional phinisi with five cabins, three king suites and two doubles, sailing Indonesia from Komodo to Raja Ampat. Voyages hold manta swims, island villages and dinners on empty beaches. Board from Komodo airport on Flores, or by way of Bali.
intros.soori-bali: Soori Bali is 48 pool villas between the rice terraces of Mount Batukaru and a black sand beach on Bali's southwest coast. Produce comes from nearby farms and spices from the resort's own garden, and sunrise at Tanah Lot is a short drive. Ngurah Rai airport is a little over an hour by road.
intros.tanah-gajah: Tanah Gajah is twenty four art filled suites and villas on a six hectare estate of gardens and working rice paddies near Ubud, once the home of the collector Hendra Hadiprana. Every stay includes club benefits, and the pool villas each have a private pool. Denpasar airport is the gateway.
intros.ungasan-clifftops: The Ungasan Clifftop Resort sits above the Indian Ocean at Uluwatu, with seven villa compounds of three to five bedrooms, each with an infinity or lap pool, a butler team and in villa dining. A beach club lies on the sand below the cliffs. Ngurah Rai airport is the nearest.
intros.viceroy-bali: Viceroy Bali is a family run retreat of 40 pool villas above the Petanu valley near Ubud, every villa with a heated private pool and a view over the jungle. Ngurah Rai airport is the gateway, and Ubud's centre is close.
intros.ja-manufaru-maldives: JA Manafaru is a natural island in Haa Alifu Atoll in the far north of the Maldives, with water villas facing sunrise and sunset and beach villas with family pools. A treehouse restaurant sits among the trees. Fly to Male, then on by domestic flight or seaplane.
intros.kudadoo-private-island: Kudadoo is a private island of overwater residences in the Maldives, built to a small footprint and run on the promise of anything, at any time. A main pavilion and pool stand on the sand, and dinners are set under lanterns in the trees. Velana airport in Male is the gateway.
intros.soneva-fushi-maldives: Soneva Fushi is the original Soneva island, Kunfunadhoo in Baa Atoll, with villas hidden in the jungle or set over the water, some with slides and stargazing roofs. Villas, Crusoe suites and estates of up to nine bedrooms suit families and couples alike. Fly to Velana airport in Male.
intros.soneva-jani-maldives: Soneva Jani is a lagoon of overwater and island villas in Noonu Atoll, most with a slide into the water and roofs that open to the stars. Water Reserves run from one to four bedrooms. Fly to Velana airport in Male.
intros.soneva-secret-maldives: Soneva Secret is a small resort on Dhipparufushi, at the westernmost tip of the Maldives, with overwater Sea Lofts and beach villas, private chefs and barefoot hosts. It links to Soneva Fushi and Soneva Jani by seaplane. From Male it is a 75 minute seaplane or a 55 minute charter.
intros.nautilus-maldives: The Nautilus is 26 houses and residences in the Baa Atoll UNESCO Biosphere Reserve, nine on the beach and eight over the lagoon, every one with a private pool. Breakfast is served anywhere, at any time. Velana airport in Male is the gateway.
intros.velaa-private-island: Velaa Private Island sits in Noonu Atoll in the north of the Maldives, with beach villas, an oval of overwater villas on the lagoon and seaplanes that land at the shore. Meals on the sand and starlit swims shape the days. Velana airport in Male is the gateway.
intros.amanpulo: Amanpulo is the only resort on Pamalican Island in the Sulu Sea, reached by Amanpulo's own flights to its own airstrip. Casitas sit in the forest canopy, on the hillside and along the beach, with villas of one to four bedrooms. Green and hawksbill turtles nest on the island. Fly to Clark for the private flight.
intros.amorita-resort: Amorita Resort sits on a cliff above Alona Beach on Panglao, with 98 rooms, suites and pool villas and a cove under the cliff with loungers on the rocks. Bohol-Panglao airport is ten minutes away.
intros.amun-ini-beach-resort-and-spa: Amun Ini is sixteen rooms above a white beach at Anda on Bohol's quiet east coast, with its own dive centre and a spa with no walls on a rocky overhang. Diving the Anda walls and trips to the Chocolate Hills and a tarsier reserve fill the days. The house arranges the drive from Bohol-Panglao airport.
intros.atmosphere-resorts-and-spa: Atmosphere Resorts and Spa is a garden resort on the Dauin coast of Negros Oriental, between the mountains and the sea, with Apo Island's reefs a short boat ride away. Pool suites, family suites and penthouses suit divers and families alike. Dumaguete airport is the nearest.
intros.banwa-private-island: Banwa Private Island is a whole island in a protected marine sanctuary off Palawan, with six beach villas and spring water pools. Banwa has recorded its 10,000th hawksbill turtle nesting, and flying foxes leave nearby Pagbu Island at sunset. Come by direct helicopter, or by road and speedboat from Puerto Princesa, El Nido or San Vicente.
intros.busuanga-bay-lodge: Busuanga Bay Lodge sits on a green hillside above Busuanga Bay, a base for the nights between flights and boats in the Calamian Islands. Its tours run to the Lusong Gunboat, a Second World War wreck shallow enough to snorkel, and to Calauit Safari Park. Busuanga airport is close, with transfers included on direct stays of two nights.
intros.cauayan-boutique-private-island: Cauayan is one of the few private islands in Bacuit Bay, El Nido, with thirty villas, eight of them with their own pools. Island hopping, diving and sunset cruises start from the jetty. From El Nido's Lio airport it is a short drive and a 20 to 30 minute speedboat, with breakfast and transfers included.
intros.discovery-coron: Discovery Coron is an island resort of 74 suites and villas on its own 19 hectares off Coron, inside the Palawan Biosphere Reserve. A white beach, forest hikes and the reefs of the Calamian Islands are at the door. Fly to Busuanga.
intros.flower-island-resort: Flower Island is a small barefoot island in Taytay Bay, Palawan, with a working pearl farm next door and a lighthouse peak to hike. Diving, island picnics and a pearl farm tour fill the days. Come by seaplane or helicopter, or fly to El Nido for a drive and a 45 minute speedboat.
intros.hotel-okura-manila: Hotel Okura Manila is a Japanese hotel opposite Terminal 3 of Manila's airport, with hinoki cypress tubs handcrafted in Nagano and a rooftop pool. Yamazato serves Japanese cuisine. It makes an easy first or last night in the Philippines.
intros.kalinaw-resort: Kalinaw Resort is six oceanfront villas on Siargao, each with a private infinity pool facing the lagoon, 800 metres from the Cloud 9 surf break. Villas sleep from four to six. Sayak airport on Siargao is the gateway.
intros.el-nido-resorts-lagen-island: Lagen Island sits between the Napuro forest and a lagoon in Bacuit Bay, El Nido, rebuilt around Filipino craft and awarded Two MICHELIN Keys. Days hold island hopping, forest trails, the new Lagen Spa and dinners in caves and on sandbars. From El Nido's Lio airport it is a 30 minute boat.
intros.el-nido-resorts-miniloc-island: Miniloc Island is El Nido's original island resort, with water cottages on stilts below limestone cliffs and verandas over the lagoon. Kayaks, island hopping and nature walks start at the door. Fly to El Nido's Lio airport for the boat transfer.
intros.nay-palad-hideaway: Nay Palad Hideaway is ten villas on Siargao's southeastern tip, formerly Dedon Island, sold all inclusive. The Perlah Villa has its own pool and private beach, and the whole hideaway books for up to 60. Sayak airport on Siargao is the gateway.
intros.el-nido-resorts-pangulasian-island: Pangulasian Island is 42 villas on a 750 metre beach in Bacuit Bay, El Nido, with canopy villas set 15 to 18 metres up in the forest. El Nido Resorts calls it the Island of the Sun for its sunrises and sunsets. Fly to El Nido's Lio airport for the boat transfer.
intros.the-bayleaf-intramuros: The Bayleaf is a boutique hotel inside Manila's walled city of Intramuros, near Fort Santiago and Rizal Park, run as the training hotel of the Lyceum of the Philippines University. Its rooftop looks out over the old walls and the skyline. Manila's airport is the gateway.
intros.two-seasons-coron-island-resort: Two Seasons Coron is a self sufficient island resort south of Coron, with a sandbar running out to an islet, a house reef and a turtle and giant clam sanctuary of its own. Bungalows sit on the beach, the hillside and the island tip. Fly to Busuanga for Coron.
intros.amanpuri: Amanpuri was Aman's first resort and still has its own peninsula above the Andaman Sea on Phuket's west coast. Forty pavilions and forty villas of up to nine bedrooms sit among the palms above the bay. Phuket airport is the gateway.
intros.anantara-golden-triangle-chiang-rai: Anantara Golden Triangle stands in a 160 acre bamboo jungle on a ridge above the Mekong and Ruak rivers, where Thailand, Laos and Myanmar meet. Rescued elephants of the Golden Triangle Asian Elephant Foundation live on the land, and guests walk with them. Chiang Rai airport is about an hour by road, or a 70 minute helicopter from Chiang Mai.
intros.four-seasons-tented-camp-golden-triangle: Four Seasons Tented Camp is fifteen tents and a two bedroom lodge in a bamboo jungle where the Ruak meets the Mekong, at the meeting point of Thailand, Myanmar and Laos. Tents have decks over the river with outdoor showers or wooden tubs, and stays are sold as all inclusive packages. Chiang Rai airport is the gateway.
intros.kamalaya-koh-samui: Kamalaya is a wellness sanctuary of 76 rooms and villas on Laem Set Beach on Koh Samui's south coast, built around a cave once used by Buddhist monks for meditation. Stays follow personal programmes of rest and renewal. Samui airport is about 45 minutes by road.
intros.keemala: Keemala is 38 pool villas on a forested hillside inland from Kamala Beach, Phuket, built as clay cottages, canvas tents, tree houses and woven bird's nests. Phuket airport is the gateway.
intros.rayavadee: Rayavadee is 94 two storey pavilions and seven villas on the Phranang Peninsula in Krabi Marine National Park, a few minutes' walk from Railay and Phranang beaches below the limestone karst. From Krabi airport it is a short drive and a 20 minute boat to the resort beach.
intros.rosewood-phuket: Rosewood Phuket runs down a hillside to its own 600 metre beach on Emerald Bay, with pool pavilions, beachfront villas and houses of up to four bedrooms. Phuket airport is the gateway.
intros.six-senses-samui: Six Senses Samui sits on a headland at the northern tip of Koh Samui, with hillside villas over the Gulf of Thailand, most with a private infinity pool. Whale sharks come through from April to September. Samui airport is a 15 minute drive.
intros.six-senses-yao-noi: Six Senses Yao Noi looks across the limestone karsts of Phang Nga Bay from every villa, on the island of Koh Yao Noi. Island hopping and the spa fill the days. From Phuket airport it is a drive and a speedboat, about 70 minutes in all.
intros.the-sarojin: The Sarojin is 56 residences in gardens beside the long beach at Khao Lak, for adults and families with children aged 10 and over. Pool residences and suites with whirlpool pavilions sit among the lily ponds. Phuket airport is the gateway.
intros.belmond-cap-juluca: Cap Juluca is a Belmond hotel of white Greco-Moorish villas among the palms on Maundays Bay, on Anguilla's southern coast. Sail to the offshore cays, dine at Pimms on the seafront terrace and end the day at the Guerlain spa. Fly to St Maarten for a 20 minute boat, or into Anguilla itself.
intros.be-tulum: BE Tulum is a Caribbean beachfront resort on the Riviera Maya, its suites and paths set into the tropical landscape. Days hold the Yäan Spa, daily yoga and dinners on the beach. Tulum airport is close, and Cancún about an hour and a half by road.
intros.casa-maya-kaan: Casa Maya Ka'an is a private seafront house inside the Sian Ka'an Biosphere Reserve, on a white sand cove between the Caribbean and the Sian Ka'an lagoon. Stays are full board with a private chef, with kayaks, paddleboards, snorkelling and sailing at the door. It lies about 12 km south of Tulum by a dirt road.
intros.chable-maroma: Chablé Maroma is seventy private pool villas in a protected stretch of jungle on Maroma Beach, each with its own plunge pool and moon shower. Jorge Vallejo's cooking is served at every table, and the temazcal and cenote diving are close by. Cancún airport is about 40 minutes by car.
intros.chable-yucatan: Chablé Yucatán is a hacienda in the Maya forest near Mérida, with a cenote at the heart of its spa, a Melipona bee sanctuary and a Maya kitchen class. Mérida airport is about 45 minutes by road.
intros.holistika: Holistika is a jungle retreat on the edge of Tulum where days run from morning yoga to plant based food, a jungle art walk and sound sessions under the Dome. Temazcal and cacao ceremonies are part of the week. Fly to Tulum or Cancún.
intros.hotel-bardo: Hotel Bardo is a hotel of private jungle villas in Tulum, built around the Mexican tradition of Día de Muertos, each villa opening to its own jungle garden or pool. Temazcal, sound healing and The Spa 13 fill the days. Fly to Tulum or Cancún.
intros.hotel-panamera: Hotel Panamera is a 36 room beach hotel on the Tulum coast, set around a central restaurant and beach club where the food and the music bring people back. Fly to Tulum or Cancún.
intros.la-valise-tulum: La Valise Tulum is a small hotel of suites on Tulum beach, some with private plunge pools, with a natural cenote and a private beach club. NÜ Tulum and the La Valise Spa are part of the stay. Tulum airport is about 30 miles away.
intros.mezzanine-tulum: Mezzanine is one of the few hotels inside Jaguar Park, the protected stretch of Tulum between the jungle and the Caribbean, steps from the Maya ruins. Its Thai kitchen sits on the cliffside terrace above the sea. Fly to Tulum or Cancún.
intros.nizuc-resort-spa: NIZUC sits on its own point between the Caribbean and the mangroves, under 15 minutes from Cancún airport, with suites, private pool villas, an ESPA spa and six restaurants. Snorkelling starts off NIZUC Beach.
intros.nomade-holbox: Nômade Temple Holbox is a wellness retreat of 30 rooms on Holbox Island, inside the Yum Balam Nature Reserve, from canvas walled rooms to treehouses raised above the ground. From Cancún it is a drive to Chiquilá and about 30 minutes across the water.
intros.nomade-tulum: Nômade Temple Tulum is a beachfront retreat on the Tulum coast with a full weekly programme of workshops, ceremonies and gatherings. Rooms, suites, treehouses and bungalows sit among the gardens, with three restaurants. Cancún airport is about two hours by road.
intros.olas-tulum: Olas is a small guesthouse in the dunes at the edge of the jungle, run on solar power and cooled by the sea breeze, with Sian Ka'an next door. Breakfast is shared around one table in the sand, and turtles nest from May to October. Tulum airport is about an hour away.
intros.radhoo-tulum: Radhoo is a 14 room jungle hotel on Tulum's beach road, built with natural woods, chukum washed walls and woven ceilings around one large pool. Guests share beach clubs and dining with its sister hotels, including NÜ Tulum. Tulum airport is about 30 miles away.
intros.siwa-tulum: SIWA is a hotel of private pool villas in Tulum's jungle, with clear water channels running through the grounds like rivers. Rituals, a rooftop shala and two restaurants keep the stay centred on rest. Fly to Tulum or Cancún.
intros.the-beach-tulum: The Beach Tulum is an adults only hotel of 28 rooms on Tulum's shore, its 90 metres of beach kept for guests alone. Rooms run from plunge pool rooms on the sand to rooftop rooms with hot tubs. Fly to Tulum or Cancún.
intros.xela-tulum: XELA is a 12 suite hotel in one of the original private villas on Tulum Beach, kept at the scale of a house, with a beach club and an izakaya. Tulum airport is about 30 miles away.
intros.casali-di-casole: Casali di Casole is eighteen restored farmhouses and villas on a 4,200 acre Tuscan estate between Siena and Volterra, each let whole with its own pool and land. A concierge, a castle's restaurants and a spa are close by. Florence is about an hour and a quarter by car.
intros.da-licenca: Dá Licença is an art filled hideaway among the olive hills of the Alentejo near Estremoz, with suites built for the view and pools that face the landscape. Olive oil comes from the estate's own groves, and the dark skies are made for stargazing. Lisbon airport is about two hours by road.
intros.beckon-capella-lodge: Capella Lodge sits beneath the volcanic peaks of Lord Howe Island, off Australia's east coast. Days hold the Mount Gower trek, snorkelling, island walks and bird watching. Flights reach Lord Howe from Sydney and Brisbane.
intros.lizard-island: Lizard Island Resort is forty rooms, suites and villas on a national park island on the Great Barrier Reef, with 24 beaches and an all inclusive stay. Take a dinghy and a picnic to a beach of your own for the day. From Cairns it is an hour's flight over the reef to the island's airstrip.
intros.beckon-longitude-131: Longitude 131 is a camp of tented pavilions among the red dunes of the Northern Territory, facing Uluru. Ayers Rock airport is the gateway.
intros.orpheus-island-lodge: Orpheus Island Lodge is fourteen rooms on a national park island in the Great Barrier Reef, all inclusive and for 28 guests at most. Step off the beach outside your room into a fringing reef. A helicopter flies in from Townsville in 30 minutes, or from Cairns in 90.
intros.pelorus-private-island: Pelorus is a 400 hectare Great Barrier Reef island with one five suite residence, always booked whole, fully hosted and all inclusive. Even a couple has the beaches, the reef, the pool and the chef to themselves. A private helicopter flies in from Townsville in 30 minutes.
intros.beckon-silky-oaks-lodge: Silky Oaks Lodge stands in the ancient rainforest above the Mossman River in Far North Queensland, with treehouse suites raised among the trees. Cairns airport is the gateway.
intros.beckon-southern-ocean-lodge: Southern Ocean Lodge sits on limestone cliffs above the Southern Ocean on Kangaroo Island, every suite facing the wild coast. Fly from Adelaide to Kingscote.
intros.beckon-the-louise: The Louise sits among the vineyards of the Barossa Valley, with the region's wineries around it. Adelaide airport is the gateway.
intros.qualia: qualia is sixty pavilions on the northern tip of Hamilton Island, above the Whitsundays, for guests aged 16 and over, many with a plunge pool over the Coral Sea. Sail to Whitehaven Beach or fly over Heart Reef. Fly direct to Hamilton Island from Sydney, Melbourne or Brisbane.
intros.dolphin-island: Dolphin Island is a 14 acre private island off the northern tip of Viti Levu, let to one party of up to eight at a time. Dive the soft corals of Bligh Water, cook with Dawn and spend a night in the Hilltop Bure. From Nadi it is a drive or a flight, then ten minutes by the island's boat.
intros.jean-michel-cousteau-resort: The Jean-Michel Cousteau Resort sits on a peninsula in Savusavu Bay on Vanua Levu, with two resident marine biologists and a kids' club that runs all day. Snorkel with the biologists, dive the Namena Marine Reserve and visit Nukubalavu village. Fly from Nadi to Savusavu in about an hour.
intros.kokomo-private-island: Kokomo is a private island on the Great Astrolabe Reef in Kadavu, with five hilltop residences and twenty one beachfront villas. Dive the reef and its manta cleaning station, picnic on Namara Beach and eat from the island farm. Kokomo's own seaplane and helicopter fly in from Nadi.
intros.laucala: Laucala is a whole island in Fiji given over to twenty four villas, each with its own pool and a personal host. Dining and most of what there is to do are included, from the reef to the rainforest, golf and horses. Arrive on Air Laucala or by private jet.
intros.likuliku-lagoon-resort: Likuliku is an adults only lagoon resort on Malolo in the Mamanuca group, with 45 bures on the lagoon, ten of them over the reef, owned by a Fijian family. Nadi is 25 km away, by catamaran, speedboat or helicopter.
intros.matangi-island: Matangi is a 240 acre, horseshoe shaped private island near Taveuni, adults only and in one family since 1878, with eight bures and three treehouses. Dive the Rainbow Reef and picnic in Horseshoe Bay. It is reached by boat or seaplane, arranged by the resort.
intros.nanuku-resort: Nanuku is a private 500 acre estate at Pacific Harbour facing Beqa Lagoon, with two miles of white beach, its own airstrip and a private island offshore. Villas and residences of up to six bedrooms suit a whole family. Fly from Nadi in 30 minutes, or drive just over two hours.
intros.six-senses-fiji: Six Senses Fiji is on Malolo, the largest of the Mamanuca Islands, with pool villas and sixteen residences of three to six bedrooms. Every villa has a private pool, and surfing is part of the stay. Nadi is 25 km away by boat or helicopter.
intros.turtle-island: Turtle Island is a family owned private island on the Blue Lagoon in the Yasawa group, with fourteen villas and almost everything included, on a five night minimum. A seaplane brings you in from Nadi in about 30 minutes.
intros.vomo-island: VOMO is a 255 acre private island between the Mamanuca and Yasawa groups, all inclusive and built around families, with seven beachfront residences that each have a butler. A helicopter flies in from Nadi in about 15 minutes.
intros.yasawa-island-resort: Yasawa Island Resort is eighteen thatched beachfront bures, the only resort on a 22 km volcanic island at the top of the Yasawa group. Picnic on any of eleven beaches and visit the Blue Lagoon Caves. A 30 minute charter flight from Nadi lands at the resort's own airstrip.
intros.le-tahaa: Le Taha'a is a Relais & Châteaux resort on Motu Tautau, with a coral garden at the door for snorkelling at any hour. Visit Taha'a's vanilla growers and Taputapuātea on Raiatea. Fly from Tahiti to Raiatea, then transfer to the motu.
intros.pearl-resort-vahine-private-island: Vahine is a private motu in the Taha'a lagoon, with nine bungalows and a royal villa for up to fourteen. Kayak the lagoon and swim the coral at the door. Fly from Tahiti to Raiatea, then about 30 minutes by boat.
intros.vanira-lodge: Vanira Lodge is ten Polynesian bungalows built from coral, wood, stone and earth in a tropical garden in the hills above Teahupo'o, at the end of the road on Tahiti Iti. Tahiti Faa'a airport is the gateway.
intros.beckon-huka-lodge: Huka Lodge stands beside the Waikato River near Taupō, one of New Zealand's best known riverside retreats. Fly to Taupō, Rotorua or Auckland.
intros.the-retreat-at-blue-lagoon: The Retreat at Blue Lagoon is a hotel set into the lava field of Iceland's Reykjanes peninsula, with the lagoon's waters around it. Keflavík airport is close by.
intros.alya-catamaran-galapagos: Alya is a catamaran of nine cabins, almost all with private balconies, sailing the Galápagos Islands. Board from Baltra.
intros.ecoventura-origin-yacht: Origin is an Ecoventura yacht that moves island to island through the Galápagos like a floating wilderness lodge, for solo travellers, couples and families. Board in the islands for the voyage.
intros.ecoventura-theory-yacht: Theory is an Ecoventura yacht for 20 guests, small enough to anchor in the quieter coves of the Galápagos.
intros.ecoventura-evolve-yacht: Evolve is an Ecoventura yacht for a small group sailing the Galápagos, for families, couples and anyone who wants the islands up close.
intros.alila-ventana-big-sur: Alila Ventana Big Sur sits in the redwoods above the Pacific on California's Big Sur coast, with a Japanese style bath and trails into the forest. Monterey airport is the nearest.
intros.lion-sands: Lion Sands is a family owned private reserve in the Sabi Sand and the Kruger, with 6.5 miles of its own frontage on the perennial Sabie River. Four lodges and two private residences share the land, from the eight suites of Ivory Lodge to Fish Eagle and Hinkwenu, taken whole. Fly into Skukuza, and the road in doubles as a first game drive.
